Players Committee card image of [[Let The Wookiee Win (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “USED: Subtract 2 from a just drawn destiny targeting your Wookiee's ability or defense value. STARTING: If your starting location had exactly two [Light Side], deploy a Kashyyyk location and three Effects that are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/let_the_wookiee_win.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/let_the_wookiee_win.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
